title: Affine polynomial ring of a relative standard chart
statement: For a finite nonempty coordinate set n, scheme S, open V of S, commutative ring R and isomorphism eV:V.toScheme≅Spec R [def-weil-affine-spectrum], put P=projective space over S, q:P→S and rho:P→Proj Z[T_k] [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For every i, W=D_+(T_i)_S∩q⁻¹(V) is affine, and there exist h:W.toScheme→V.toScheme and a ring equivalence E:R[U_j:j≠i]≅Γ(P,W). They satisfy h≫V.ι=W.ι≫q. E(C r) is W.topIso.hom applied to (h≫eV.hom).appTop(ΓSpecIso R.inv r), and E(X j) is the restriction to W of rho-sharp(T_j/T_i) on D_+(T_i)_S.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma (Tag 01NG, label lemma-standard-covering-projective-space) for the charts of P^n_Z; Lemma (Tag 01MV, label lemma-principal-open) and Lemma (Tag 01MS, label lemma-when-invertible) for the non-vanishing locus of T_i and the generator of O(1) on D_+(T_i); Definition (Section Tag 01ND, label definition-projective-space) for the base change; with Schemes, Lemmas 01JR and 01I4 (literature/stacks-project/schemes.tex) for the restriction over Spec R

proof.text: Use the proved upstream standardOpenIso and its compatibility with the integral chart. For a variable X j, projIntBasicOpenIso_hom, ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, basicOpenToSpec_app_top and homogeneousLocalizationAwayXEquiv_symm_X show that its image on the integral chart is awayToSection(awayXRatio i j). Restrict along toProjInt using resLE_app_top; this proves the standardOpenIso coordinate formula. Both helper lemmas are proved privately in the delivered module.

Put W = standardOpen i ∩ q⁻¹(V), take the canonical h = q.resLE V W inf_le_right and a = homOfLE inf_le_left. Paste Mathlib isPullback_opens_inf with isPullback_morphismRestrict q V to prove that (a,h) is the restriction pullback. Transport the chart corner along standardOpenIso and compare with the proved AffineSpace.isPullback_map V.ι. Pullback uniqueness constructs e:W≅A(J;V), J={j≠i}. Since eV identifies V with Spec R, V and A(J;V), hence W, are affine.

Map affine spaces along the given isomorphism eV, with inverse given by AffineSpace.map eV.inv, and compose e with this isomorphism and Mathlib AffineSpace.SpecIso J R. Global sections of the resulting d:W≅Spec R[J], followed by W.topIso, give a bijective ring map F:R[J]→Γ(P,W). AffineSpace.SpecIso_hom_appTop and the pullback projection identities compute F(C r) as W.topIso.hom((h≫eV.hom).appTop(ΓSpecIso R.inv r)). They compute F(X j) as the restriction of the coordinate formula from step 1, using Scheme.homOfLE_appTop_topIso_inv. Polynomial ringHom_ext identifies F with eval₂Hom of these coefficients and ratios. RingEquiv.ofBijective gives E; eval₂_C and eval₂_X prove the requested formulas, and resLE_comp_ι gives the required square.

theorem projectiveSpace_standardCharts_part3 (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u})
    [Finite n] [Nonempty n] :
    ∀ (V : S.Opens) (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (eV : V.toScheme ≅ Spec R) (i : n),
      IsAffineOpen (standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V) ∧
      ∃ (h : (standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ⟶ V.toScheme)
        (E : MvPolynomial {j : n // j ≠ i} R ≃+*
          Γ(ℙ(n; S), standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
        h ≫ V.ι = (standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ∧
        (∀ r : R, E (MvPolynomial.C r) =
          (standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V).topIso.hom
            ((h ≫ eV.hom).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r))) ∧
        ∀ j : {j : n // j ≠ i}, E (MvPolynomial.X j) =
          (ℙ(n; S)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (inf_le_left : standardOpen n S i ⊓ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ standardOpen n S i)).op
          ((toProjInt n S).app
            (Proj.basicOpen (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (MvPolynomial.X i))
            (Proj.awayToSection _ _ (MvPolynomial.awayXRatio (ULift.{u} ℤ) i j.1)))
